x509_trust_path.scope: X.509 only; MTC credentials unchanged; mutual uses D on both sides

definitions.process_wall_ms: host monotonic time around one Docker client process; includes process/container overhead
definitions.tcp_connect_wall_ms_native: native client connection entry through successful TCP connect return
definitions.handshake_wall_ms: native TLS handshake start through handshake completion
definitions.x509_verification_ms: client wall time in the native peer-certificate verification path; inclusive of the custom MTC callback for MTC credentials
definitions.credential_verification_total_ms: compatibility-equivalent value for x509_verification_ms; the inclusive ssl_verify_internal interval for X.509 or MTC credentials
definitions.client_authentication_verification_total: per-connection sum accumulated directly in C from two local monotonic intervals: ssl_verify_internal and tls_process_cert_verify; it excludes the TLS state transition and network wait between them
definitions.mtc_credential_auth_ms: complete MTC credential callback interval; unavailable for X.509
definitions.merkle_proof_ms: client wall time to reconstruct the MTC leaf and evaluate its Merkle inclusion proof; unavailable for X.509
definitions.landmark_validation_ms: client wall time to validate the reconstructed root against trusted landmark/subtree state; available only for MTC landmark credentials
definitions.standalone_validation_ms: client wall time to validate the standalone MTC root signatures; available only for MTC standalone credentials
definitions.certificate_verify_ms: client wall time to process and cryptographically verify the peer TLS CertificateVerify message
definitions.credential_verification_other_ms: credential_verification_total_ms minus applicable Merkle, Landmark and Standalone suboperations; missing suboperations count as zero only for this derived value
definitions.connection_establishment_wall_ms_native: native connection entry through TLS handshake completion
definitions.tls_bytes_total: OpenSSL TLS handshake bytes read plus written; excludes IP/TCP headers
definitions.tcp_handshake_ms: PCAP time from initial client TCP SYN to the corresponding client ACK completing the three-way handshake
definitions.tcp_syn_to_clienthello_ms: PCAP time from initial client TCP SYN to the first client ClientHello
definitions.tls_clienthello_to_client_finished_ms: PCAP time from the first client ClientHello to the client Finished
definitions.tcp_syn_to_first_application_request_ms: PCAP time from initial client TCP SYN to the first decrypted client HTTP request
definitions.tls_handshake_bytes: complete logical TLS records in the handshake interval, including each five-byte record header once
definitions.tls_client_handshake_wire_bytes: sum of frame lengths for client TCP-payload frames from ClientHello through client Finished, inclusive
definitions.tls_server_handshake_wire_bytes: sum of frame lengths for server TCP-payload frames over the same TLS interval
definitions.tls_handshake_wire_bytes: client plus server handshake wire bytes; pure TCP ACKs are excluded
definitions.tcp_handshake_wire_bytes: sum of frame lengths for the SYN, corresponding SYN/ACK and first ACK completing the selected TCP stream handshake
definitions.connection_handshake_wire_bytes: sum of unique frame lengths across the TCP three-way handshake and TLS handshake interval; an ACK carrying TLS data is counted once
definitions.tls_handshake_packets: client plus server TCP-payload frames in the TLS handshake interval
definitions.tls_client_certificate_bytes: complete client Certificate handshake message, including its four-byte handshake header; zero only when not requested; applies to X.509 and project MTC credentials carried in Certificate
definitions.tls_server_certificate_bytes: complete server Certificate handshake message, including its four-byte handshake header; applies to X.509 and project MTC credentials carried in Certificate
definitions.tls_certificate_verify_bytes: complete CertificateVerify handshake message, including its four-byte handshake header
definitions.tls_certificate_verify_signature_bytes: signature vector contents after validating the TLS 1.3 algorithm and uint16 length fields
definitions.mtc_proof_bytes: complete MTCProof carried in the MTC certificate signatureValue; unavailable for X.509
definitions.mtc_merkle_path_bytes: MTCProof inclusion-path vector contents; excludes its uint16 length
definitions.sct_bytes: encoded SCT-list extension value; zero means a parsed certificate with no SCT extension, blank means unavailable
definitions.tls_authentication_bytes: Certificate plus CertificateVerify handshake messages, without TLS record overhead; Finished and CertificateRequest are excluded
definitions.tcp_retransmission_packets: retransmitted frames retained in wire-byte and packet counts but deduplicated from logical TLS bytes
